name: Cloudflare security-audit skill
tagline: Coding-agent skill from Cloudflare that runs a six-phase security audit where fresh agents try to disprove every finding before it reaches the report

xSignals.text: One agent finds a bug. A fresh agent tries to prove it wrong. Cloudflare's Security Audit skill is MIT licensed. Model costs still apply; it isn't continuous security monitoring. Would you use this before shipping?
